all agree: doubt whether it entered or not -- say it did not enter
all agree: doubt whether a dog or a cat -- say a dog

all agree: it cut off the head of one of them -- its anger subsided
all agree: it roars and they cluck -- they are frightening one another
they dispute where it is silent and they cluck
one master holds: it is acting upon them

Ameimar: I did not hear [Rav's]
